sn48.70:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci Supaṇṇānaṃ rukkhā Kūṭasimbali tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn48.70:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci bodhapakkhikā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam bodhāya || || 3.
sn48.70:1.4: Saddhindriyam bhikkhave- -bodhāya saṃvattati || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ- -bodhāya saṃvattati || ||
sn48.70:1.5: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci Supaṇṇānam rukkhā Kūṭasimbali tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
